gift.Moon: Reading people and making them feel looked after
gift.Mars: Energy to start things and push them through
gift.Mercury: Quick thinking, and explaining things so people get them
gift.Jupiter: Good judgement, and helping others grow
gift.Venus: Tact, taste and keeping things pleasant
gift.Saturn: Patience, and finishing what you start
gift.Rahu: Courage to try new and unusual things
gift.Ketu: Deep focus when you work on your own

nature.fire: You meet the world warmly and directly, and people notice when you walk in.
nature.earth: You meet the world steadily and practically, and people trust you to get things done.
nature.air: You meet the world with curiosity and talk, and you make friends easily.
nature.water: You meet the world with feeling, and you sense moods before anyone says a word.

mind.3: Inside, you feel deeply and care hard for the people you love.
mind.4: Inside, you have a proud, warm heart that needs to be appreciated.
mind.5: Inside, you are careful and thoughtful, and you can worry too much.
mind.6: Inside, you need harmony; arguments unsettle you more than most.
mind.7: Inside, your feelings are intense and private.
mind.8: Inside, you are hopeful and free-spirited, and you need room to roam.
mind.9: Inside, you are serious and controlled, and you keep worries to yourself.
mind.10: Inside, you are independent and a little detached: you think before you feel.
mind.11: Inside, you are soft, dreamy and sensitive to everything around you.

life.watchIntro: Things that tend to trip you up:
life.chaptersBody: Your life moves in long chapters. The one you are in now runs until {{end}}: {{meaning}} Inside it, the current stretch lasts until {{subEnd}}: {{subMeaning}}

Sun.lead: You do your best work out front, trusted with something that matters.
Sun.more: Work that keeps you hidden or feels pointless tires you faster than hard work does. You stay loyal to places that treat you fairly.

Moon.lead: You do your best work close to people, in work that feels useful to them.
Moon.more: The mood of a workplace matters to you more than you admit. Your career may change shape a few times, and that is fine.

Mars.lead: You do your best work with a clear target and room to act fast.
Mars.more: Slow meetings and red tape wear you down. Technical, physical or competitive work brings out your best.

Mercury.lead: You do your best work where your mind and your words are the tools.
Mercury.more: You pick things up quickly and like variety. Writing, trading, teaching or tech suit you better than repeating one task.

Jupiter.lead: You do your best work when you can guide, teach or advise.
Jupiter.more: People come to you for judgement. You grow fastest under a good mentor, and later you become one.

Venus.lead: You do your best work where things are pleasant, fair and well made.
Venus.more: Creative, people-facing or design work suits you. A good team and a nice place to work keep you going.

Saturn.more: You earn trust through steady effort, not quick wins. Rewards come later than for others, but they stay.

Rahu.lead: You are drawn to unusual work: new fields, tech or work far from home.
Rahu.more: Big ambitions push you forward. You can rise fast if you stay grounded and finish what you begin.

Ketu.lead: You do your best work alone, on something you can go deep into.
Ketu.more: Titles and praise matter less to you than doing it well. Research or expert work suits you.

career.link: Your work is closely tied to {{place}}.
career.strongIntro: What other people count on you for:
career.watchIntro: Things that tend to trip you up at work:
career.watchIntroBusy: Things that tend to trip you up, more so in these months:

money.Sun: Money comes through your position and your good name. You spend on looking good and on the people who depend on you.
money.Moon: Your income can rise and fall, but you rarely go without. You spend on home, food and the people you love.
money.Mars: You earn through effort and quick decisions. Watch impulse buys and lending to friends.
money.Mercury: Money comes best through skill, trade and talk, less through quick bets.
money.Jupiter: Money grows slowly and steadily, often through advice, teaching or family support. You are generous, sometimes too generous.
money.Venus: Money comes through comfort, creativity and good relations. You like nice things, so a saving rule helps.
money.Saturn: Money comes slowly, through long, steady work. You are careful with it, and savings grow over time.
money.Rahu: Money can come in sudden jumps, from new or far-off sources. Keep a cushion: what comes fast can go fast.
money.Ketu: Money matters less to you than meaning, which can leave gaps. Simple, automatic saving works better than big plans.

via.Sun: people in charge and public work
via.Saturn: slow, steady jobs and long service
via.Rahu: tech, foreign links and new fields

career.rule: One simple rule suits you: decide what you save first, then spend what is left.

Sun.lead: You need a partner you can respect and be proud of.
Sun.more: You give loyalty and expect it back. Clashes come when both of you want the last word.

Moon.lead: You need a partner who makes you feel safe and cared for.
Moon.more: Feelings run deep in your close ties. A warm, steady home life matters more than grand gestures.

Mars.lead: You need a partner with energy and spirit, someone who stands up to you.
Mars.more: Attraction runs strong. Arguments can flare fast, so cooling down before talking helps.

Mercury.lead: You need a partner you can talk to about anything.
Mercury.more: Friendship and laughter are the glue for you. Long silences worry you more than arguments.

Jupiter.lead: You need a partner who shares your values and helps you grow.
Jupiter.more: Respect, trust and a shared sense of right matter most. You often learn a lot from the people you love.

Venus.lead: You need warmth and affection, and a little beauty, in love.
Venus.more: You give a lot of care and want it noticed. Harmony matters, sometimes so much that you avoid talks you need to have.

Saturn.lead: You take commitment seriously and need a partner who is steady and reliable.
Saturn.more: Love may come later or grow slowly, but it is built to last. Duty and care keep it going.

Rahu.lead: You are drawn to partners who are different from you, in background, culture or way of life.
Rahu.more: That spark is real. Clear, honest talk about plans keeps it from turning into confusion.

Ketu.lead: You need space, and a partner who doesn’t crowd you.
Ketu.more: You can seem distant even when you care. Saying what you feel out loud helps a lot.

give.fire: You love openly and generously. You plan the surprises and say the warm words first.
give.earth: You show love through steady, practical care: being there, keeping promises, making life easier.
give.air: You show love through talk, ideas and fun. You keep things light and make your partner laugh.
give.water: You love deeply and quietly. You remember the small things and notice when something is wrong.

love.giveStrong: Your capacity for affection is a real strength in your chart.
love.giveWeak: You may doubt yourself in love. You are easier to love than you think.
love.watchIntro: Patterns to notice in close relationships:

watch.Sun: Needing to be right in an argument
watch.Moon: Taking a partner’s bad mood as your fault
watch.Mars: Saying sharp things in the heat of the moment
watch.Mercury: Talking things through instead of feeling them
watch.Jupiter: Advising when your partner wants to be heard
watch.Venus: Avoiding hard talks to keep the peace
watch.Saturn: Holding back affection until you feel sure
watch.Ketu: Going quiet and pulling away when hurt

health.top: About energy and rest, not illness. For anything about your health, please see a doctor.

Sun.lead: Your energy is strong when you have a purpose, and daylight.
Sun.more: Days without a goal leave you flat. Morning light and an early start suit you.

Moon.lead: Your energy follows your feelings and your sleep.
Moon.more: A calm evening and regular meals keep you steady. Crowded weeks drain you more than hard work does.

Mars.lead: You have quick, strong energy that needs an outlet.
Mars.more: Moving every day keeps your head clear. Without it, the energy turns into irritation.

Mercury.lead: Your energy lives in your mind: busy, quick and easily scattered.
Mercury.more: Screens and noise wear you out. Short breaks and a walk clear your head.

Jupiter.lead: Your energy is generally steady and hopeful.
Jupiter.more: You recover well when you rest, but you tend to overdo food, work or plans.

Venus.lead: Your energy does best with comfort and enough sleep.
Venus.more: Pleasant surroundings recharge you. Very rich food and late nights pull you down.

Saturn.lead: Your energy is slow to start, but it lasts.
Saturn.more: Fixed routines suit you better than bursts. Warmth, sleep and gentle stretching help.

Rahu.lead: Your energy comes in surges and dips.
Rahu.more: Excitement can keep you going past your limit. Regular sleep matters more for you than for most.

Ketu.more: Time alone recharges you. Notice when you skip meals or forget your body while lost in thought.

health.stressIntro: Signs that you are running low:

fire: Skipping meals when you are busy
Restless sleep after a full day
earth: Tension in your neck and back
air: Feeling scattered and forgetting small things

rest.fire: Rest for you is active: a walk, a game, time outdoors. Then a proper wind-down before bed.
rest.earth: You rest best with routine: the same sleep time, a warm meal, time in nature or working with your hands.
rest.air: You rest best when your mind can stop: music, a slow walk without your phone, writing things down before bed.
rest.water: You rest best with quiet and with people who feel safe: water, a bath, a calm evening at home.

health.restSade: These years ask for a little more rest than usual. Plan it in, rather than waiting until you are tired.

fire.lead: You learn fastest by doing, and by being challenged.
fire.more: Short, intense sessions work better than long, slow ones. A goal or a contest keeps you going.

earth.lead: You learn step by step, and you remember what you can use.
earth.more: Notes, practice and repetition work for you. Once you learn something, it stays.

air.lead: You learn through talk, questions and ideas.
air.more: Study groups, explaining things out loud and variety help. Learning by heart alone bores you.

water.lead: You learn best when you care about the subject, or the teacher.
water.more: A calm place and a good teacher make a big difference. Pictures and stories help things stick.

study.mindStrong: A clear, quick mind is one of the strengths in your chart.
study.mindWeak: Facts may take a little longer to hold. Repetition and good notes fix that.

focus.fire: Your focus is strong but short. Work in short bursts with breaks, and start with the hardest task.
focus.earth: Your focus is steady once you settle in. Protect a fixed study time and a tidy place to work.
focus.air: Your mind jumps to new ideas. Put the phone in another room and give yourself one task at a time.
focus.water: Your focus follows your mood. Sort out worries first, or write them down, then study.

course.Sun: Subjects with leadership and public life suit you: management, government, politics or medicine.
course.Moon: Subjects that care for people suit you: nursing, psychology, hospitality, food or teaching young children.
course.Mars: Practical, technical subjects suit you: engineering, sport, defence, surgery or property.
course.Mercury: Subjects of words, numbers and machines suit you: languages, commerce, accounts, computing or media.
course.Jupiter: Subjects of knowledge and guidance suit you: law, teaching, finance, philosophy or counselling.
course.Venus: Creative and people subjects suit you: design, arts, fashion, music, hospitality or diplomacy.
course.Saturn: Long, solid courses suit you: science, engineering, administration, history or research.
course.Rahu: New and unusual fields suit you: technology, foreign languages, aviation or study abroad.
course.Ketu: Deep, specialist subjects suit you: research, mathematics, coding, healing or philosophy.

study.courseEnd: Choose something you would still enjoy after the first year, not only what pays.

Sun.lead: You want a home you are proud of, and you often take charge there.
Sun.more: Respect inside the family matters to you. Let others lead sometimes.

Moon.lead: Home is your safe place, and you put a lot of feeling into it.
Moon.more: Family moods affect you deeply. Small rituals together keep the peace.

Mars.lead: Home life is lively, with strong opinions and quick tempers.
Mars.more: You protect your family hard. The home itself may need effort, repairs or a move.

Mercury.lead: Home is busy and full of talk.
Mercury.more: You keep the family connected. Plans and paperwork at home often land with you.

Jupiter.lead: Home tends to be a place of support and good values.
Jupiter.more: Elders and tradition matter in your family. You may host a lot.

Venus.more: You bring harmony to the family, and you spend happily on your home.

Saturn.lead: Home life asks for patience and duty.
Saturn.more: You may carry responsibility early. A settled home often comes later, and it lasts.

Rahu.lead: Your home life may be unusual, or move around a lot.
Rahu.more: You may live far from where you grew up. Make your own small traditions.

Ketu.lead: You can feel a little apart, even at home.
Ketu.more: You need a quiet corner of your own. Peace comes from simple, uncluttered living.

mother.strong: Your mother, or whoever raised you, is a real source of strength in your chart.
mother.mid: Your bond with your mother is close and ordinary: care, with some friction.
mother.weak: Your bond with your mother may have had distance or strain. Patience on both sides helps.

father.strong: Your father, or a father figure, gives you backing and good values.
father.mid: Your father’s role in your life is steady, with times of disagreement.
father.weak: Your father may have been away, busy or hard to reach. Mentors can fill some of that space.

children.Sun: With children you lead by example and expect a lot. Praise works better than pressure.
children.Moon: You are a warm, protective figure for children, your own or other people’s.
children.Mars: You are the active, playful one with children. Patience is the skill to grow.
children.Mercury: You connect with children through talk, games and curiosity.
children.Jupiter: Children are a traditional blessing in your chart, and you guide them well.
children.Venus: You bring fun, affection and creativity to children’s lives.
children.Saturn: Children may come later or bring responsibility; your care is steady and lasting.
children.Rahu: Children around you may take unusual paths. Give them room and they shine.
children.Ketu: You give children space and calm. Make time to show affection openly.

Jupiter.title: A more open, supported time
Jupiter.life: Jupiter starts a year-long pass over you. People see you more clearly.
Jupiter.career: Jupiter starts a year-long pass over your work life. A good time to ask for more responsibility.
Jupiter.love: Jupiter starts a year-long pass over love. Good for meeting people and for commitment.
Jupiter.health: Jupiter starts a year-long pass over your energy. Good for starting habits that last.
Jupiter.study: Jupiter starts a year-long pass over learning. Good for starting a course or an exam push.
Jupiter.family: Jupiter starts a year-long pass over home and family. Good for family plans and gatherings.

Saturn.title: A time for steady effort
Saturn.life: Saturn starts a slow pass over you, about two and a half years. Slow down, simplify and build.
Saturn.career: Saturn starts a slow pass over work. Progress takes patience, but what you build now lasts.
Saturn.love: Saturn starts a slow pass over love. Commitment gets serious; take things step by step.
Saturn.health: Saturn starts a slow pass over your energy. Fixed routines and sleep matter more now.
Saturn.study: Saturn starts a slow pass over learning. Steady daily study beats last-minute pushes.
Saturn.family: Saturn starts a slow pass over home. Duties at home grow, so share them.

Rahu.title: A restless new pull
Rahu.life: Rahu moves over you for about a year and a half. Big wants and fresh starts; stay grounded.
Rahu.career: Rahu moves into your work life for about a year and a half. New fields and offers pull at you; check them before you jump.
Rahu.love: Rahu moves into love for about a year and a half. Unusual attractions and quick feelings; give them time.
Rahu.health: Rahu moves through your energy for about a year and a half. Keep sleep and screen time in check.
Rahu.study: Rahu moves into learning for about a year and a half. New subjects excite you; finish one before the next.
Rahu.family: Rahu moves into home life for about a year and a half. Moves or changes at home are possible; keep talking.

Jupiter.title: Support moves elsewhere
Jupiter.sub: Jupiter moves on. Keep the habits you built while things were easy.

Saturn.title: A slow test eases
Saturn.sub: Saturn moves on, and the pressure here lifts.

Rahu.title: Restlessness settles
Rahu.sub: Rahu moves on, and things here feel calmer.

sadeEnd.title: A long test ends
sadeEnd.sub: Saturn’s seven-and-a-half-year pass over your Moon finishes. Pressure starts to lift.

sadeStart.title: A long, slow test begins
sadeStart.sub: Saturn starts its seven-and-a-half-year pass over your Moon. Slow down, simplify and keep routines steady. It is a building time, not a bad time.

title.family: Best window for a home of your own

window.strong: The life timeline and the slow planets line up here, peaking around {{peak}}.
window.steady: A steady window rather than a dramatic one, best around {{peak}}.

habit.Sun: Get morning light and set one clear goal for the week.
habit.Moon: Call someone close, and eat a proper home meal.
habit.Mars: Move your body hard for half an hour.
habit.Mercury: Learn something small, or clear your messages and lists.
habit.Jupiter: Read, teach, or help someone with advice.
habit.Venus: Make something beautiful, or tidy and brighten your space.
habit.Rahu: Take a few hours away from screens.
habit.Ketu: Spend an hour in quiet, on your own.

oneThing.t: Do one thing at a time
oneThing.s: Pick the one change that matters most this year and give it your best hours.

journal.s: Two lines a day. Within a month your own patterns become clear.

people.t: Spend time with people who lift you
people.s: Your energy follows the company you keep.

body.s: Every other plan runs on them.

oneGoal.t: Pick one goal for the next 18 months
oneGoal.s: Write it down. Say no to things that don’t serve it.

waitMonth.t: Wait a month before a big move
waitMonth.s: If you still want the new job after 30 days, go.

wins.s: Note what you finished each week. Use it when you ask for a raise.

saveFirst.s: Move a fixed amount to savings the day you are paid.

skill.t: Learn one skill properly this year
skill.s: A course or certificate pays off more than a new title right now.

mentor.s: Someone a few steps ahead of you can save you years.

talk.s: Twenty minutes, phones away: what went well, what didn’t.

sayIt.t: Say the kind thing out loud
sayIt.s: Appreciation said is worth far more than appreciation felt.

coolDown.s: Agree on a pause word for heated moments.

slow.s: Give a new attraction three months before big decisions.

ownLife.t: Keep your own friends and interests
ownLife.s: A full life of your own makes you a better partner.

sleep.t: The same sleep time every night
sleep.s: Even at weekends. It is the biggest single lever for your energy.

move.s: A brisk walk counts. Twenty minutes is enough.

light.s: Ten minutes outdoors early in the day sets your body clock.

screens.t: An hour without screens before bed

checkup.s: See a doctor about anything that worries you. This report is about energy, not illness.

plan.s: Three study blocks a day, with breaks, at the same times.

teach.s: Explaining a topic out loud shows you what you don’t know yet.

phone.t: Study with the phone in another room
phone.s: Forty-five minutes of real focus beats three distracted hours.

review.s: A quick look at today’s notes tomorrow morning helps you remember far more.

ask.s: A teacher or a friend can save you a week of being stuck.

meal.s: No phones. It is where small problems get solved early.

call.t: Call your parents or elders regularly
call.s: A short, regular call beats a long, rare one.

share.s: Write down who does what. Fairness keeps the peace.

corner.t: Keep a quiet corner for yourself
corner.s: Even a chair by a window. Calm at home starts with you.

listen.s: Most family tension eases when people feel heard.

compat.title: Compatibility

mars.none: nothing to worry about for either of you. We show this plainly and never sell a fix.
mars.exempt: Mars sits in a sensitive place for one of you, but a traditional exception cancels it. Nothing to worry about.
mars.cancelled: both of you have Mars in a sensitive place, which tradition counts as balancing out.
mars.one: {{name}} has Mars in a traditionally sensitive place. Many families look at the full charts; it is a note, not a verdict, and needs no paid fix.

partner.differ: Money, pace, and how you rest
partner.home: Living together, families on both sides
partner.helps: Small habits for you two. All free

friend.connect: What you bring out in each other

family.differ: Old patterns and how to soften them

line.sameElement: You see the world in a similar way, which makes everyday life easy.
line.fireAir: One of you sparks ideas and the other fans them; you energise each other.
line.earthWater: One of you builds and the other nurtures; together you make a safe base.
line.fireWater: One of you acts fast and the other feels deeply; patience turns that into balance.
line.fireEarth: One of you jumps and the other plans; that mix works when you both say what you need.
line.airWater: One of you thinks it through and the other feels it through; listening bridges the gap.
line.airEarth: One of you dreams up the plan and the other makes it real.

partnerTail.high: The traditional count is kind to you two.
partnerTail.mid: Talk early about money and plans, and it goes a long way.
partnerTail.low: The traditional count is low, which mostly means: talk more, assume less.

line.friendTail: Say what you need from each other and the friendship holds.
line.familyTail: Small, regular time together matters more than big gestures.

good.varna: You see work and duty in a similar way
good.vashya: A natural pull towards each other
good.tara: Your birth stars favour each other
good.maitri: You understand each other’s minds easily
good.bhakoot: Your emotional rhythms sit well together

weak.varna: You see work and duty differently; respect each other’s way
weak.vashya: Neither of you naturally gives way; take turns leading
weak.tara: Timing between you can feel off; plan big things together
weak.yoni: Different instincts about closeness; talk about it
weak.maitri: Your minds work differently; ask before you assume
weak.gana: Different temperaments; one needs calm, the other action
weak.bhakoot: Your moods move to different rhythms; give each other room
weak.nadi: Similar constitutions; look after each other’s rest

compat.differNone: No big friction points stand out. The usual work of any close tie applies: listen, and say what you need.
compat.homeBody: At home, {{a}} wants {{ha}} and {{b}} wants {{hb}}. Agree early on how you share chores, money and time with both families.

homeWant.fire: a lively home with room to do things
homeWant.air: a sociable home full of talk

clash.gana: One of you wants calm and the other wants action. Take turns choosing the plan.
clash.bhakoot: Your moods run on different clocks. Give each other a day before settling an argument.
clash.nadi: You can drain each other when you are both tired. Plan easy time together, not only busy time.
clash.none: Little friction stands out. Pride is the usual trap: be the first to call after a quarrel.

family.connect: {{a}} shows care by being {{ea}}; {{b}} shows it by being {{eb}}. {{line}}

hard.gana: Old patterns flare when one of you pushes and the other withdraws. Name it, gently.
hard.bhakoot: You feel things at different times. A short cooling-off period helps more than talking in the heat of it.
hard.nadi: When one of you is low, the other often is too. Lean on others in the family as well.
hard.none: There are few sharp edges. Most tension will come from busy lives, not from who you are.

family.connectSame: Both of you show care by being {{e}}. {{line}}

compat.timingBody: Warmer stretches ahead for the two of you, from both your life chapters and Jupiter’s moves.
compat.timingNone: No standout windows in the next two years. Steady, ordinary time together is the good time.

friend.s: Pride costs friendships more than arguments do.

family.s: A meal or a call each week beats a big visit once a year.
Ask: do you want help, or do you want me to listen?
Talk about today, not about who was right years ago.
